login nahi ho pa raha
help chahiye
ji haan
thik hai
koi baat nahi

items.context: Did you receive the OTP on your phone?
items.text: otp nahi mila

items.context: Have you checked your SMS inbox and spam folder?
items.text: ab tak nahi aya

items.context: Is your registered mobile number ending with 1234?
items.text: phone number sahi hai
mera net banking me login karne par otp nahi aa raha hai
mobile banking app open kar raha hu par otp receive nahi ho raha
maine account number enter kiya hai par message nahi aaya abhi tak
meri registered number pe otp bhejte ho par wo receive nahi kar pa raha hu
kya aap verify kar sakte ho ki mera number active hai kya otp ke liye
reset karne ki koshish ki par otp nhi aata is wajah se problem ho rahi
mba app update karne ke baad bhi otp nahi mil raha mujhe

items.context: Can you confirm if your phone network is working properly?
items.text: haan phone sahi hai par fir bhi otp nahi mil raha

items.context: Have you recently changed your SIM or phone?
items.text: mera sim card change nahi kiya recent me abhi bhi wahi number par message nahi aarha

items.context: Are you using any SMS blocking apps or services?
items.text: message blocked hone ke chance nahi hain mere phone me

items.context: Have you checked whether your SMS inbox is full?
items.text: also please check if your phone memory is not full

items.context: Did the bank inform you any outage or problem in OTP service?
items.text: iple ne bhi kaha ki system me koi problem nahi hai
mujhe apna net banking me login karna hai lekin otp time par receive nahi kar pa raha hu mai bar bar try karta hu magar captcha ke baad otp nahi aata
mobile banking app se paisa transfer karna tha lekin otp nahi aaya jis wajah se transaction adhura reh gaya main is masle ka turant hal chahta hu
registration ke time mera mobile number sahi hai lekin aaj se otp receive nahi ho raha ho sakta hai ki koi technical problem ho is vishay me aap thoda madad karein

items.context: Can you please confirm if the mobile number linked to your account is correct?
items.text: maine phone number double check kiya hai aur correct hai phir bhi otp nahi aa raha hai

items.context: Is there any known technical issue with OTP delivery in our banking portal currently?
items.text: kya aapke system me kuch dikkat chal rahi hai jis wajah se otp time par nahi mil raha

items.context: Have you contacted your mobile service provider to check network issues?
items.text: maine apne phone ke network provider se bhi baat ki aur unhone kaha sab sahi hai to bank me check karen ki problem kya hai

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: banking
Intent: login_otp_problem - cannot log in to net or mobile banking or is not receiving the OTP
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with numbers (account and phone numbers, OTPs, amounts, dates) written as numerals, with long numbers spaced in groups the way people say them

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
